true_answer: It has run uninterrupted for millennia.[24] Solar calendars assign a date to each solar day.[5] A day may consist of the period between sunrise and sunset, with a following period of night, or it may be a period between successive events such as two sunsets.[25][26] e length of the interval between two such successive events may be allowed to vary slightly during the year, or it may be averaged into a mean solar day. Other types of calendar may also use a solar day.
